sexually_explicit.findings: Multiple government bodies removed this book specifically citing sexual content after formal review of specific material: South Carolina's State Board of Education (SBE Order 2025-0003, Feb. 4, 2025) removed it statewide after a committee presented the board with reviewed examples described as developmentally inappropriate sexual content; Escambia County, FL removed it in Nov. 2022 after a department-chair challenger characterized the book as containing 'a lot of oral sex, bestiality and things of that nature' (an attributed challenger claim, not independently confirmed by an admissible source describing the actual passage). PEN America and NCAC document the book's recurring national challenge rationale as sexually explicit content, masturbation, and a childhood-sexual-abuse (incest) storyline. A 2016 Dubuque, IA challenge alleging 'graphic sex scenes' was reviewed and the district's committee voted 10-0 to retain the book, showing the finding is disputed between sources. Kirkus's professional review notes only that 'some might object to the sexuality, drinking, and dope-smoking' — a mild, non-specific caution, not a scene description.
